title: Health insurance
official: If the policyholder dies, the claim money is paid to the nominee. In a family floater policy, all family members share one sum insured.
suggestion: Tell the insurer about the death. If others in the family are on the same policy, ask how their cover continues.
confirms: IRDAI health FAQ: on death of policyholder, claim proceeds go to the nominee; floater members share one sum insured.
